card.name: Linking words before "any other component"
card.fires_on: The comma or the word "to" right after a list of named drugs in a hypersensitivity contraindication, just before "or (to) any other ingredient/excipient/component".

modes.label: "or to" before excipients
modes.description: The word "to" after "or" at the end of a list of drugs the patient is hypersensitive to.
modes.example: to any other ACE inhibitor, to amlodipine, or<< to>> any of the excipients of aml

modes.label: Comma before "or any"
modes.description: The comma after the last named drug, ahead of "or any other component".
modes.example: known hypersensitivity to bupropion, dextromethorphan<<,>> or other components of AUVELITY.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a hypersensitivity warning where the list of named drugs ends and "any other ingredient" is about to come.
